FIELDS.NAME: Golf & Sport Supply Co.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Golf & Sport Supply Co. operates as a premier retail establishment specializing in a wide range of golf and sporting equipment and accessories. Our store offers a curated selection of high-quality products tailored for amateur and professional athletes, recreational players, and fitness enthusiasts. We pride ourselves on providing exceptional customer service, ensuring our staff is well-trained in product knowledge to assist customers effectively. The store maintains a clean and organized environment, minimizing any potential safety hazards. Moreover, we have implemented clear, documented safety protocols to enhance the shopping experience while safeguarding our customers and employees. Our operations do not include any on-site sporting events or repair services, which helps us manage and reduce liability exposure. Our commitment to financial stability and positive cash flow allows us to provide a reliable shopping experience for our customers throughout the year.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Losses from theft and vandalism occurring on January 5, 2023, resulting in a total loss of $2,500. The claim is currently under review by the insurance adjuster.
FIELDS.Combined Single Limit: $1,000,000 Combined Single Limit with a $2,500 deductible
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Mon-Sat 9:00 AM - 7:00 PM, Sun 10:00 AM - 5:00 PM
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: UL Class II Commercial Safe, Grade 1, TL-15 Rated
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Professionally monitored alarm system and motion sensor security protection with regular inspections.
